organisation: Dakahlia Group for Poultry and Agricultural Development

_notes.discount_rate: Organisation's nominal cost of capital. Egyptian rates are high and volatile - set this deliberately, it is printed on every report.
_notes.salvage_decay_per_year: Fraction of current resale value lost per additional year in service.
_notes.benchmark_unavailability: Downtime a well-run NEW unit would itself incur, as a fraction of run hours. Only downtime above this is charged as a cost of keeping the old asset.
_notes.economic_materiality: Replacing must beat keeping by at least this fraction of the new unit's annual cost before the verdict is escalated. Guards against acting on estimation noise.
